title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 11
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．１１
overview:
Flash Sega Saturn Vol. 11 is a Japanese promotional disc from Sega's Flash Sega Saturn series, offering playable trial versions of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Digital Pinball: Necronomicon
- Sekai no Shasou kara I Swiss-hen: Alps Tozantetsudou no Tabi
- Sexy Parodius
- Vatlva
- Victory Goal WORLD WIDE edition
